observations: What I read for this request: the first-reading section of the new 07 request (found with Grep; firstReadingHash fae3863282c37772214a6d16b40719a8ba86507af8e909b41c1fc3f10c104c73 and request fingerprint 314e86c2..., both confirmed). I took the page 07 script from the boundary context in the page 08 request. I also used source/original.txt and source/REVISION-2026-11-11.md, which I had read earlier in this session. In this pass I opened workflow/review/page-07.png, page-08.png and page-09.png with Read and looked at them. Earlier in this session I had also looked at assets/panels/07-1.png. I did not open the panel art for 07-2 to 07-4 or storyboards/page-07.svg. Read shows each page at about 1024 px wide and I cannot zoom, so pixel distances are estimates from the page and the script rectangles.

Page 07 looks the same as in my previous pass. All five text items match source PAGE 7 word for word. The exchange reads in order (Meera's statement, Ravi's question, Meera's answer, then the farewell caption), and no reply is skipped.

07-1, first-reader concern that the balloon touches Meera's hair: the 07-1 art (1424x720, scaled about 0.694) puts her outermost hair strand at about page x 292-300, and the balloon edge is at about x 297. At most a few pixels of the outer hair contour meet the balloon. Her face, eyes, ear and earring are clear. The tail ends at the side of her head and points only at her. Acceptable.

07-2, first-reader concerns: the tail tip touches the side of Ravi's hair, but he is the only person in the panel, so the speaker is clear. The label (about x 24-292, y 765-868) is flush with the panel's left border, which is normal for a label. Its bottom edge is about 8 px above the protected thumb and phone (starting y 876), so both stay fully visible. Acceptable.

07-3: the tail points down to Meera, well left of Ravi, who is seen from behind at the right edge. 07-4: the caption covers only the awning and wall. All three faces, Ravi's waving hand and his phone are clear. The walkthrough Meera offers in 07-3 happens off-panel before 07-4. That is an acceptable small skip in time, because the caption sums up the visit.

Reading the page cold, without guides: first the top-left balloon; then, in the middle row, Ravi's balloon and the label below it, then Meera's balloon to the right. The two middle-row balloons sit at the same height on either side of a clear gutter, and reading left before right puts the question before the answer. The bottom caption closes the page.
No balloons are close enough to be mistaken for one another.

transitions.observation: The scene cuts from the consultation room to reception. Ravi has his bag on his shoulder and his phone in hand, so he has come back to the desk after the consultation. Meera and the desk identify the place even without a caption.
Meera points at Ravi's dark-blue phone. The next panel is a closer shot of the same phone in his hands, screen toward the reader.
After Ravi's question, the reverse shot shows Meera answering, with Ravi's back and phone in the right foreground. Meera stays on the left and Ravi on the right, as in 07-1.
The scene moves outside. Ravi walks away waving, with his phone in his left hand and his bag on his shoulder, while Ananya and Meera wave from the door. The caption closes the visit.

After Ravi leaves in morning sun, the page turn opens on a pharmacy. The caption 'Meanwhile, the pharmacy is notified...' places it while he heads away. The NEW PRESCRIPTION label, which now sits directly above the pharmacy tablet, links back to 'intelligent prescribing' on page 06.

The scene change without a caption and the off-panel walkthrough are readable skips in time, which agrees with the first reader's own conclusion.
